author: Emmanuel12346

title: Some changes are needed for sure
body:
Hi Structured team,

First, thank you for creating such an amazing app. Structured has become my main app for planning my day because I love the timeline view and how easy it is to organize my schedule.

One feature that I think would make the app even better is custom colors for events and tasks.

Right now, if I create all of my events directly in Structured (school, church, CCA, appointments, etc.), they all look very similar. Apple Calendar events can have different colors based on their calendar, but native Structured events cannot.

It would be incredibly helpful if users could:

* Assign a color to individual events or tasks.
* Or create categories/calendars (e.g. School, Exercise, Church, Personal) with their own colors.
* Optionally filter or view events by these categories.

For example, I’d love to quickly distinguish:

* 🔵 School
* 🟢 Sports / CCA
* 🟣 Church
* 🟠 Personal
* 🔴 Important events

This would make the timeline much easier to scan at a glance, especially for students and people who use Structured as their primary planning app.

Thank you for all the work you put into Structured. I hope you’ll consider adding this feature in a future update!

title: Favourite scheduling app
body:
I have been using Structured for about 2 years, and decided to go for the lifetime subscription. It is easy to use, with options to set it as a one time thing, recurring (non-stop or up until a certain date), and set subtasks. I love that I can set different colours, and group tasks according to colour. I do have some minor issues though:

- no overview of a week or month planning. You have to scroll day to day
- no search function, e.g. I want to find out when I’m doing something, I gotta know when-ish it is happening.
- icons can be a wee bit limiting, but not a huge issue. 
- I love the function that allows me to move tasks to another time, or date, without going into the edit mode. However, it is hard to set the time correct, I feel like an enlarged function will be useful.

title: Overall great app, but..
body:
I find it unnecessarily troublesome to select the task start time. I get that hiding the time between tasks let us focus on the existing tasks more, but can you give us a way to view the day’s full timeline? Then drag-to-reschedule will be easier, and can let us directly create the task from the specific time slot (rather than needing to scroll thru the time wheel from day to night…)

Also is there any way to hide the “answer email” hint when creating new task?? This hint distracts me and make me forget what i was about to write lollll

Currently, I'm using the free version and am pretty satisfied with it, so I will continue to use it and consider getting the Pro version (Any student discounts or promotions? 🥹) One thing I dislike about this app is that it takes awhile for the buttons to react when I press them. Whenever I press the Settings/Inbox/Calendar/+ icons and buttons, they don't respond until I repeatedly press them. I don't know how to resolve this and I've already restarted the app & my iPhone.
